items.title: Graphical Representation of a Vector (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Graphical Representation of a Vector: a main subheading of 2.2 Vectors, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 23-23.

blocks.text: Vector quantity dikhane ka achha tareeqa vector diagram hai, jis mein vectors ko arrow (teer) se dikhaya jata hai. Arrow ki length magnitude batati hai aur arrow ka head (sira) direction batata hai. Kitab mein vectors bold (mote) letters se likhe jate hain (jaise V, F) ya letter ke oopar arrow bana kar (A⃗).
